supporting.document: README Document for the Global Landslide Nowcast from LHASA, Version 2.0.0 (GES DISC, 2023)
supporting.quote: combines satellite rainfall estimates from the Global Precipitation Measurement mission (GPM) with soil moisture estimates from the Soil Moisture Active Passive (SMAP) satellite

relationships.rationale: Decision step 3: total-profile soil wetness and snow mass from SMAP L4 are predictor layers of the model (antecedent conditions); the nowcast is not a reprocessing of soil moisture; INPUT. Cited by title as Version 4; CMR now holds only 008.

metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation points to the record itself (Global_Landslide_Nowcast 2.0.0) and has no Type; it should be removed or replaced with the lineage below.
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-snppcrisl1bnsr-4) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.
Platforms is ['MODELS'] only; the input missions (GPM, SMAP) are not recorded.
The ATBD is inconsistent about the rainfall input: its text says the IMERG Early product (30 min), its Table 1 cites "GPM (IMERG) Late Precipitation L3 1 Day … V06B".
The inputs used (IMERG V06B, SMAP L4 Version 4) are no longer in CMR (IMERG V07 and SPL4SMGP 008 only).
Abstract and README say version 2.0.0 "retains replaces the heuristic decision tree from version 1.0" (garbled).
The README file-name example "Global_Landslide_Nowcast_v.2.0.0_20150403.nc4" does not match the granules ("Global_Landslide_Nowcast_v2.0.0_20150403.nc4").

excluded.detail: NHESS names "IMERG (version 6B)" only; Early, Late and Final runs at 30-min and daily steps all exist (rules 1c-3, 1c-6).
ATBD text says "IMERG Early Product … 30 min"; its dataset citation names the Late daily product, which is written.
NHESS: "Gridded Population of the World version 4 ... adjusted to the UN WPP Population Density for 2015"; the revision is not stated.
Other versions of the target are never listed (Generation Skill 1a, version_of); a row would be a self-relation.
